image_prompts.prompt: The character-consistent Albertosaurus from the config library slumped at the finish line. SUBJECT ANCHOR: Slate-blue skin, navy racing stripes, red-tipped eye crests, and exactly TWO claws per hand. ACTION: He is leaning heavily against the wooden post of the finish line, his body sagging with fatigue. One leg is bent at a sharp angle. HANDS: His small two-fingered hands are limp at his sides, fingers dangling loosely. FACIAL EXPRESSION: The smugness is gone; his eyes are wide and glazed with exhaustion, and his tongue is lolling out comically from the side of his mouth. Puffs of steam come from his nostrils. SETTING: The prehistoric finish line track, late afternoon sun. ART STYLE: 'STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3' with physical comedy. LIGHTING: 'SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC'. FRAMING: 'SQUARE_HERO_CARD' medium shot to focus on the contrast between his sleek design and his total lack of energy.
